asks: Is this idea worth a slot this week?
not_to_be_confused_with: arc_cards.components, which asks whether an arc is real at all
quality/panel, which asks whether finished work is good enough to ship
note: Three different questions. Run them in order. Never average them into one number.

scale.per: criterion, scored by the machine before Krish votes

criteria.label: Owned angle
criteria.covers: A way in nobody else has taken.

criteria.label: The number
criteria.covers: A figure to chase that changes what the reader thinks.

criteria.label: Fun
criteria.covers: Funny, surprising or delightful rather than grim. Entertained ranked first of six on the felt result.

criteria.label: Reader fit
criteria.covers: Does the leader of a five to fifty million pound business see themselves in it.

criteria.label: Makeable
criteria.covers: Two to four of Krish's hours with the engine doing the rest.

criteria.label: Preach risk
criteria.covers: How close it sits to a sermon. Inverted: a high raw score is bad.

criteria.label: Material exists
criteria.covers: Does the evidence already exist, or must it be created. He has never once commissioned a piece needing fresh primary research.

gates.rule: A signature idea with fresh <= 2 is cut unless fun >= 4 or angle >= 4. Broad-coverage pieces are exempt but capped.
gates.why: A well-covered topic only survives if it has been forced into a genuinely funny or unique angle.

gates.rule: At most two broad-coverage pieces live at once.
gates.why: They exist for relevance, not for the archive.
It gets written, then checked hard on the closing paragraph. A flag is not a verdict.
An idea without a number to chase is a thought, not a piece.

the_vote.two_votes_never_one: A quality call and a separate timing call. 'Not now' is a scheduling verdict, and scoring it as a quality verdict punishes an idea for arriving in the wrong week.
the_vote.force_a_better_angle: Sends an idea back to be re-pitched rather than killing it.
the_vote.note: A free-text note per idea, and the machine score shown beside the vote. The delta is the training signal and the reason the board exists.
